data.narrative:
Asymm is a seed-stage space and aerospace company founded by Omar Kunbargi that has raised $6M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 13 comparable companies across the Space & Aerospace sector—5 publicly traded (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, and ICEYE.

Of the three standard valuation methods tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This approach uses the $6M raised as a baseline proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of the Seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding an implied valuation of $15M. Peer-Median comparison was inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Space & Aerospace peer set (only 1 same-stage company identified). Public-Comp Anchoring using the sector's 24.4x median P/S multiple across 6 tickers could not be executed without the target's revenue figures, which remain undisclosed as is standard for private companies at this stage.

The triangulated valuation range is $13M to $17M, with a median point of $15M. This range reflects the single applicable method and should be treated with corresponding caution. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of direct peer data at the seed stage and the absence of revenue visibility needed for market-multiple cross-checks. A more robust analysis would require either narrower comparables or disclosed financial metrics.
